title: 月面余氧
subtitle: SELENE / LAST OXYGEN
brief: 月面货运基地断电。按 A 电力、B 冷却、C 密封的顺序抢修，再进入东侧气闸。氧气持续流失，冲刺更耗氧；S 柜可补满氧气。低重力可跃上矮箱，也要小心暴露在无人机视线中。

en.title: Lunar Reserve
en.brief: The lunar freight base has lost power. Repair A power, B cooling and C seals in that order, then reach the east airlock. Oxygen drains continuously and sprinting uses more. S cabinets refill oxygen. Low gravity lets you jump onto low crates, but drones can spot you in the open.
